column4: If the aggregate initial principal amount of the notes is $1,250,150,000, the fair value calculation assumed that when the allocation between the Class A-2 Notes is determined on or before the date of pricing, the maximum amount of Class A-2-A Notes that would be issued is $456,110,000 (in which case, $0 of Class A-2-B Notes would be issued) and the minimum amount of the Class A-2-A Notes that would be issued is $114,030,000 (in which case $342,080,000 of Class A-2-B Notes would be issued).
